items.response: CHECK (125 RPM max drop, 75 RPM max differential)

items.text: When reaching cruise altitude above 5,000’ MSL, promptly switch fuel selector from BOTH to either LEFT or RIGHT and then to opposite tank to ensure both tanks are feeding.
During cruise, use LEFT and RIGHT tank (not BOTH) as required to manage fuel balance.
Repeat START checklist beginning on step 10 (do not reprime).

items.response: LEAN TO 50 RPM DROP BELOW BEST POWER

items.text: If IFR (or VFR in Class B, C, D airspace): Transponder
If failure occurs in VFR conditions, or VFR conditions are encountered after failure, continue flight under VFR and land as soon as practicable.
VFR Landing at a Controlled Field:
Remain outside or above Class D airspace until traffic flow determined.
Transmit intentions "in the blind" advising tower of aircraft type, position, altitude, and intention to land.
Enter pattern, report position "in the blind", and watch for light signals from tower.
If failure occurs in IFR conditions, continue flight according to the following:
Altitude (highest of for the route segment being flown): (MEA)
E – Expected as Advised by ATC
From enroute altitude upon reaching the IAF but not before:
ETA as calculated from filed ETE
